_doc: Tuning for population, upkeep, debt and events. See docs/architecture.md (Empire depth).

garrison._doc: Every claimed system fields `base` orbital batteries, plus one more per `pop_per_extra` population in its colonies (at most `max`).

deposits._doc: Strategic deposits on bodies: richness 1-3 is rolled with these weights; a development that extracts a deposit yields per_richness x richness of it per turn. Major powers start with start_stock unless their campaign gives an amount.

jobs._doc: Cancelling a constructor job refunds this fraction of its cost.

market._doc: Credits per unit the Free Traders pay; buying costs twice that (TradeRules).

raid._doc: A major power's raid on a system it blockades (RaidCommand): like a barbarian plunder spec.
